name: Azariah (priest)
title: Priest, son of Hilkiah
summary: Azariah was a priest in the high priestly line, the son of Hilkiah who found the Book of the Law in the temple. He is mentioned in the genealogy leading to Ezra.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the priests' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Azariah is listed as the son of Hilkiah in the line of high priests.
